dataset_version: ACL 2021 Official Dev Split (75-Question Diagnostic Subset)

details.question_selection: First 15 consecutive questions across 15 documents from official tatqa_dataset_dev.json
details.prediction_generation_integrity: Predictions generated strictly from table, paragraphs, and question without access to gold answers, derivations, or answer scales. Standalone prediction file saved to data/evaluation/tatqa_predictions.json.
details.benchmark_scope_disclaimer: Diagnostic subset evaluation over 75 questions. This does NOT represent full benchmark performance across all 1,668 dev set questions.

sample_failures.question: What is the company paid on a cost-plus type contract?
expected: our allowable incurred costs plus a profit which can be fixed or variable depending on the contract’s fee arrangement up to predetermined funding levels determined by the customer
